title: Locally finite presentation of representing immersion

source.place: first three proof paragraphs: rank decomposition and the fibre product of the two lowest-cohomology loci

proof.text: Decompose the base into the open-and-closed rank components. On each component, the lowest-cohomology rank-locus theorem applied to the module and its dual gives immersions locally of finite presentation; their fibre product represents the conjunction of the two universal rank conditions. The componentwise pieces glue by uniqueness from the universal property, and local finite presentation is local on the target.
